title: Accounts Assistant
company: JANE GORSE RECRUITMENT LIMITED - Agency - Permanent
description:
Accounts Assistant

Hale £25,000-£28,000

Supporting the Legal Cashiering Team

Good with numbers? Love getting the detail right? Ready for your next move in accounts?

Jane Gorse Recruitment is recruiting an Accounts Assistant to join an established law firm in Hale. You'll support the Legal Cashiering Team, helping to keep transactions accurate, payments running smoothly and financial records in excellent shape.

If you enjoy balancing the books, solving queries and being the person your colleagues can rely on, this could be a great next step.

The role

Working closely with the legal cashiers and wider business, you'll get involved in:
- Posting transactions accurately to client and office ledgers.
- Processing payments, cheque requests and account transfers.
- Completing daily bank reconciliations.
- Helping prepare weekly payment runs.
- Maintaining financial records and investigating ledger queries.
- Supporting month-end processes and VAT returns.
- Assisting with petty cash and residual client balances.
- Following the procedures that keep client money protected and accounts compliant.
- Providing cover for colleagues and suggesting ways to improve everyday processes.

What you'll bring

We're keen to hear from candidates with accounts experience, strong attention to detail and a proactive approach.

You'll be someone who:
- Enjoys working with numbers and checking that everything adds up.
- Has experience with financial transactions, reconciliations or maintaining accounts records.
- Communicates clearly and confidently with colleagues.
- Can organise a varied workload and meet deadlines.
- Handles sensitive financial information with care and discretion.
- Is comfortable using accounts software and learning new systems.
- Takes pride in being helpful, reliable and accurate.

Experience within a legal accounts team would be useful. If your background is in a different sector, please highlight your relevant accounts experience and interest in moving into legal finance.

The benefits

There's plenty on offer beyond the £25,000-£28,000 salary:
- Employee bonus scheme offering up to an additional 10% of annual salary, subject to terms and conditions.
- Your birthday off.
- Healthcare package including 24/7 GP access and contributions towards dental, optical and physiotherapy costs.
- Gym membership.
- Death-in-service cover of four times your salary.
- Company pension.
- Counselling support and monthly office massages.
- A range of lifestyle benefits, including Netflix, Spotify and Amazon Prime.

Benefits are subject to the employer's scheme terms and eligibility.

Ready to make your next move?

Apply with your CV to Jane Gorse Recruitment. We'd love to hear about your accounts experience and what you're looking for next.

Accounts Assistant Role Overview

A great opportunity for an Accounts Assistant to join our client based in Altrincham on a 12 month FTC. This role is primarily focused on managing the day-to-day purchase ledger function, including processing supplier invoices, reconciling statements and handling supplier queries. Alongside these responsibilities, you will also support the wider finance team with month-end procedures and the preparation of management accounts, providing an excellent opportunity to develop your accounting knowledge and gain broader experience within the finance function.

Accounts Assistant Responsibilities:
- Processing and coding supplier invoices accurately.
- Matching invoices to purchase orders and resolving supplier queries.
- Reconciling supplier statements and assisting with payment runs.
- Maintaining accurate purchase ledger records.
- Assisting with month-end procedures, including accruals and prepayments.
- Preparing bank, supplier and balance sheet reconciliations.
- Assisting with journal postings and maintaining the nominal ledger.
- Supporting the preparation of monthly management accounts.
- Assisting with financial reports and investigating discrepancies.
- Providing general support to the wider finance team as required.

Accounts Assistant Experience Required
- Previous experience working within a purchase ledger role is essential.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage workloads effectively.
- Competent IT skills, including Microsoft Excel
- Exposure to month-end processes and management accounts would be desirable.
- A willingness to develop wider accounting skills and support the management accounts function.

Why Should you Apply?

This is a great opportunity for an experienced Purchase Ledger professional to join a finance team in a varied role, with the added benefit of gaining exposure to management accounts and developing their wider accounting skills. Offering a mix of transactional finance and month-end support, this position is ideal for someone looking to broaden their experience. title: Credit Controller
company: Axon Moore Group Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Axon Moore are working with a growing business based in Altrincham to recruit a Credit Control Clerk into a newly created, standalone position.

This is a great opportunity for an experienced Credit Controller who enjoys a varied role, likes to get stuck in and wants the autonomy to take ownership of the ledger and make the role their own.

The business is continuing to grow, and this role will play an important part in supporting cash flow, maintaining strong customer relationships and improving processes across the finance function.

Location: Altrincham + Hybrid
Salary: £28,000 - £32,000

Main duties:

The position will be varied and is about much more than just chasing cash! Responsibilities will include:
- Raising and issuing accurate sales invoices and credit notes.
- Managing a ledger of B2 B customer accounts and proactively chasing outstanding debt.
- Reviewing aged debt, monitoring credit limits and escalating potential risks.
- Allocating customer payments and supporting month-end reconciliations.
- Investigating and resolving invoice queries, pricing discrepancies and customer debit notes.
- Working closely with sales, commercial and logistics teams to resolve queries.
- Maintaining accurate customer records and supporting new account setups and credit checks.
- Supporting improvements to processes, including the development of EDI and automation.
- Providing regular reporting and updates on aged debt, cash collection and outstanding queries.

Person specification:
- Previous experience in a B2 B credit control or sales ledger role.
- Ideally, experience within manufacturing, retail, FMCG or wholesale.
- Confident managing customer accounts, chasing debt and resolving queries independently.
- Organised, proactive and comfortable working in a standalone position.
- Someone who enjoys a challenge, takes ownership and is keen to contribute to a growing business.

Benefits:
- Early finish Fridays.
- Free on-site parking.
- Hybrid working
- 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays.
- An additional day off for your birthday.
- Health cash plan, including cashback on eligible healthcare costs.
- Dental and eyecare benefits.
- Discounted gym membership.
- Electric car leasing scheme.
- Enhanced maternity and paternity pay.
- Company bonus.
